findings.title: Cleanup/finish skipped on failure paths
findings.message: If the native command fails or times out, the exception is raised after the probes and host.finish() have run, but a failure of host.command itself (or probes) skips finish(). The nonzero stderr check also rejects any benign stderr output, making the run brittle.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the body in try/finally so host.finish() always runs, and check the exit status rather than treating any stderr bytes as failure.
findings.evidence: if not passed(result['native']) or result['native']['logs']['stderr']['bytes']:raise ValueError('framework command failure')

findings.title: Gate depends on placeholder commit metadata
findings.message: preparation-commit.json is written with head 'PENDING_REVIEW_COMMIT' and review_complete False, and the committed copy isn't updated in this diff; the run gate can never pass without a manual edit, which is also excluded from the dirty check only if committed. Also, the plan's own files are under docs and would make the tree dirty.
findings.suggestion: Document and automate the step that sets the real head and review_complete, and verify it is committed before running.
findings.evidence: a.need(head==commit['head'] and not dirty and commit['review_complete'] is True,'pending prepared clean checkpoint drift')

finding.title: Hard-coded absolute user path
finding.message: Hard-coded absolute developer paths make scripts and recorded evidence unreproducible on any other machine, and pins keyed by absolute paths break elsewhere.
finding.suggestion: Derive the repo root from __file__ or accept it as an argument/env variable.
